notes.title: New Demo with Revamped Art!
notes.notes:
Remember I told you, some months ago, that we've got a new main artist working on Deep in the Forest?
Well, I'm really excited to be able to finally introduce her! [b]Pandrea[/b] makes the most handsome bishonen you can dream of, and you should be all following her [url=https://twitter.com/panononi]Twitter[/url] and drool with me!

The demo is taking part in the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], so this is the perfect occasion to update the game with the new, beautiful art made by Pandrea. So far, only the MC and three of the love interests are finished, but the game will be updated as the new art is ready to be added.

So, if you haven't played the demo yet, what are you waiting for? ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202403/16715cec3636ca4557d779facbdbca8280859b12.png[/img]

notes.title: INTRODUCING A NEW MAIN ARTIST FOR THE GAME!
notes.notes:
Yes, you read it correctly: after listening to some feedback from players and weighing the pros and cons of replacing now all the art of [b][i]Deep in the Forest[/i][/b], I've decided to hire another artist, with a more classical otome style. 

The new artist's name is [b]Pano[/b], and you can check out her work here: [url=https://twitter.com/panononi]https://twitter.com/panononi[/url]

I hope you all like her art style! I think it's pretty and quite unique, and [i][b]Deep in the Forest[/b][/i]'s characters will look amazing! Of course, that means there will be a small delay, but I think the wait will be worth it if that means we'll have a better game.

What do you think? Happy with the change, or not? Please, let me know! We'll probably run a [b]Kickstarter[/b] campaign once my current game, [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i], is released, to allow [b]Pano[/b] to focus full-time on making the art for [i][b]Deep in the Forest[/b][/i]. We'll keep you updated about the new characters' designs and the KS campaign!

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
The demo of [i][b]Deep in the Forest[/b][/i] has received an update, fixing some known issues (inventory sometimes generating bugs, malfunction in the potion making mini-game if you didn't have enough herbs for it).

We have also added [b]Senan[/b]'s introduction (the sixth love interest out of seven), and a few scenes so you can get to know the love interests and the village's daily life... before stuff starts to happen and shit hits the fan, hehehe! Enjoy the flirting while you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202403/a2a0b0a57cbccc3733589000821fbb406a043d75.png[/img]

notes.title: Change of release date
notes.notes:
Hi! As many of you surely know, Ertal Games is currently working towards the release of another visual novel, [i][b]Night and Day[/b][/i], so until the game is finally released [i][b]Deep in the Forest[/b][/i]'s production is on hold. The release date we put on Steam was always meant to be a placeholder (although we really expected to make it in time; my sincere apologies for the delay).

That doesn't mean[i][b] DitF[/b][/i] is completely forgotten, far from it! Our character artist, [b]Sinnia[/b], is working on the two final love interests of the game, of which I can already show you one. And we'll update the demo with [b]Senan[/b]'s introduction and a bit more of the plot before this 2021 finishes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40202403/1ac1b28afb0a3500b8b869ba08343234e24e19a0.png[/img]

[h3]So we can confidently announce that the definitive release date for [i][b]Deep in the Forest[/b][/i] is [b]July 2022.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Demo Final Update!
notes.notes:
I guess the current demo is the definitive state of the start of the game... unless something major happens, of course!

[b]What has been added?[/b]

[list]
[*] The fifth love interest, Ganter the Cheeky Knight (two guys more will appear in the full game).

[*] The second mini-game: let's make potions! So far, it's easy and more like a tutorial... but trust me, it will get difficult as the game progresses.

[*] Some small tweaks, like edits in the English text and more sounds added.
[/list]

With Ganter finally in the game, we'll get a glimpse of the true plot of the story... or did you think picking up plants and flirting was all that Jan had to do? If so... think again!

Just in time for the Next Fest on Steam in June, by the way! If you like the game, help us win visibility by wishlisting it, please!
